subtopic: The Argand Plane and Polar Representation
title: Argument, polar and De Moivre toolkit

board_content.latex: \arg(z_1 z_2)=\arg z_1+\arg z_2,\quad \arg(z_1/z_2)=\arg z_1-\arg z_2,\quad \arg\bar z=-\arg z

segments_english.text: Here is the polar toolkit on a single board, your quick reference for everything in this subtopic.
The modulus r is root x squared plus y squared, and the principal argument theta lives in the interval minus pi to pi, with pi included.

Find the reference angle as inverse tangent of the size of y over x, then place it: quadrant one gives alpha, quadrant two gives pi minus alpha, quadrant three gives alpha minus pi, quadrant four gives minus alpha.
Polar form itself: z equals r times cosine theta plus i sine theta, also written r cis theta.
The argument algebra: product adds arguments, quotient subtracts them, and conjugation negates the argument.
De Moivre for powers: z to the n equals r to the n times cosine n theta plus i sine n theta, for any integer n.
The cube roots of unity: one, omega, and omega squared, with omega cubed equal to one and their sum equal to zero.

<whisper>And three angles worth memorizing outright:</whisper> one plus i is root two at forty five degrees, one plus i root three is two at sixty degrees, and root three plus i is two at thirty degrees. They recur constantly.

segments_hinglish.text: Ye raha polar toolkit ek single board par, is subtopic ki har cheez ke liye aapka quick reference.
Modulus r hai root x square plus y square, aur principal argument theta interval minus pi se pi mein rehta hai, pi included.

Reference angle nikaalo inverse tangent of the size of y over x, phir use place karo: quadrant one deta hai alpha, quadrant two deta hai pi minus alpha, quadrant three deta hai alpha minus pi, quadrant four deta hai minus alpha.
Polar form khud: z equals r times cosine theta plus i sine theta, jise r cis theta bhi likha jaata hai.
Argument algebra: product arguments add karta hai, quotient subtract karta hai, aur conjugation argument negate karta hai.
Powers ke liye De Moivre: z to the n barabar r to the n times cosine n theta plus i sine n theta, kisi bhi integer n ke liye.
Cube roots of unity: one, omega, aur omega squared, omega cubed barabar one aur unka sum barabar zero.

<whisper>Aur teen angles seedhe yaad karne layak:</whisper> one plus i hai root two at forty five degrees, one plus i root three hai two at sixty degrees, aur root three plus i hai two at thirty degrees. Ye lagataar aate hain.
